newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bank unions call one-day strike for April 4.
newsitem.headline: French bank unions call one-day strike for April 4.

text.p: The five main French banking trade unions said on Monday they were calling a one-day strike on April 4 against a possible unilateral decision to repeal a 1937 decree which limits bank opening hours.

Bernard Dufil, secretary general of the Socialist CFDT union bank division told Reuters that unions -- CGT, CFDT, FO, CFTC, SNB -- were not opposed to reorganisation of work time, but that this would have to be negotiated.
The 1937 decree obliges banks, among other things, to allow staff two consecutive days off per seven-day week.
Dufil said unions were keen to press for a cut in working hours in any negotiation on reforming the 1937 decree.
